{{Quote|Doss captured five men. Four are here. Where's the fifth? ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''Aboard their ship. ''[&hellip;]'' Not Doss's ship&mdash;their ship. ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki></nowiki>|Emperor's Hand Mara Jade and Bok Yost|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> '''Doss's ship''', which was equipped with an [[Engine/Legends|engine]], traveled where the [[Hand of Judgment]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] deserter group was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by its owner, the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Mikhtor Doss]]. Shortly after, [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Doss's forces and inquired the mercenary's client, the [[Politics/Legends|politician]] [[Bok Yost]], where Hand of Judgment member [[Korlo Brightwater]] was being held. Yost then stated that the former stormtrooper was aboard [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[TL-1800 transport|TL-1800 freighter]] ''[[Melnor Spear]]'', not aboard Doss's ship.<ref name="Choices of One" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doss's ship was mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices of One" />
